queer_characters.name: Blanca Evangelista
queer_characters.notes: House mother central to the ballroom family; storyline centers ambition, chosen family, and dignity.

queer_creators.name: Ryan Murphy
queer_creators.notes: Co-creator and executive producer; publicly out.

queer_creators.name: Janet Mock
queer_creators.notes: Writer, director, and producer on the series; first trans woman of color to write and direct an episode of television for a major U.S. network.

contributor_notes: Largest cast of transgender actors in series regular roles for a scripted series at the time of its premiere. Set in NYC ballroom culture across the late 1980s–1990s.
